summary: Clarivate Plc filed an 8-K announcing pricing terms for a previously announced cash tender offer by wholly-owned subsidiary Clarivate Science Holdings Corporation for its 3.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2028. The offer caps purchases at $75,000,000 aggregate principal (the Tender Cap), subject to proration, with the Expiration Date set at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on September 23, 2026. The Reference Yield and Total Consideration were disclosed. The company may waive, increase, or decrease the Tender Cap. Watch for proration and acceptance results as the debt-retirement mechanics unfold.
